description: Batch read: 1 to 20 pages of the Radix Wiki in full in one call, which is how to read search or listing results. Pass `paths` as the listings return them. Paths that do not exist come back in `missing` rather than failing the call, anything past 20 in `remaining`, and pages past `maxChars` (default 250000) in `omitted` with their sizes.

maxChars.description: Total characters across the pages returned (default 250000, max 1000000)

name: get_pages
title: Read up to 20 pages
